This paper is published here by kind permission of the IBC. Copyright © IBC. ThE AUThORS Sripal Mehta is principal architect, broadcast at Dolby Laboratories. His focus is the innovation, development and deployment of next-generation audio. Mehta has spent 15 years at Dolby working in the areas of professional audio, digital cinema security, and playback, and most recently, object-based immersive and personalized audio for the cinema and home. As a member of SMPTE, he has authored two digital cinema standards and has chaired the digital cinema security subcommittee. Mehta holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in electrical and computer engineering from Carnegie Mellon University.
